status: post-primary bounded silicon feasibility study; protocol amended after a recorded zero-correct-candidate feasibility stop; not independent confirmatory evidence

design_selection.eligibility: A design must have at least one oracle-correct emitted candidate in the SFT arm and at least one across the pooled two-seed RF arm. This is necessary to instantiate both sides of a functional board pair.
design_selection.rule: For each family independently, among correctness-eligible designs choose the sealed design with the lexicographically smallest SHA-256 of sealed_split_sha256_lf + ':' + family + ':' + design.

candidate_selection.rule: Within each arm/design, group oracle-correct candidates by emitted RTL SHA-256, sum sample multiplicity across that arm's frozen endpoint seed directories, choose the largest total multiplicity, then the lexicographically smallest RTL SHA-256; use the lexicographically smallest source module as representative.
candidate_selection.post_selection_gate: The selected representative must have a successful row in the already-complete Vivado PPA audit; failure stops the board study and does not trigger reselection.

measurement.pairing: within-design SFT versus RF under identical selection and sweep rules

stop_rules: The original outcome-independent design-selection attempt and its zero-correct-candidate stop remain recorded; do not describe the amended board subset as independently selected.
The sweep-floor amendment from 20 to 5 MHz was made before any silicon result, using only the already-sealed post-selection Vivado rows; do not present it as originally frozen.
Do not change designs or candidates after generation or board inspection.
Do not create a silicon result unless all ten DUT/golden self-checks and the canary pass before bitstream construction.
Do not report a DUT Fmax when it is within the frozen canary margin.
A missing, incomplete, or unreachable board remains no silicon claim.
The board result cannot change the sealed Study 2 primary outcome.
